function: function (p. 5): the learned PAEnet estimates and detects target UAVs' delay-Doppler indices from OTFS radar echoes at the BSs; sensing alone, with no communication link modeled or evaluated.
notes: Reason function (sensing alone in a system that does not communicate). The learned PAEnet (attention residual CNN ESnet, LSTM PRnet, MLP Funet) performs radar sensing of target UAVs: p. 1 "we consider an OTFS communication waveform-based UAV sensing situation"; p. 3 "An ESnet is constructed to extract the delay and Doppler parameters for UAV sensing"; p. 5 "BS-1 and BS-2 ... transmit the OTFS signal and process the echo signal reflected by the UAV individually" and "the symbol sent at the radar detector is known"; p. 7 "OTFS waveform-based radar detection". The UAVs are non-cooperative targets (p. 1: "passive detection of unknown UAVs via communication signals"); no communication receiver, data detection, or communication metric is modeled, and results are NMSE of target delay/Doppler indices and detection rate against LS, LMMSE, CNN, and CA-CFAR (pp. 10-12). Communication appears only as motivation (Fig. 1, p. 2) and as the origin of the waveform. Not area 4, because the DD-domain estimate is of target echo parameters (range and velocity), not of a communication channel or of data symbols; not area 5, because no beam, waveform, or resource is designed; not area 6, because no UAV link is controlled. The reviewer may confirm this boundary with area 4 (learned OTFS delay-Doppler parameter estimation). Title and DOI 10.1109/JIOT.2025.3571754 confirmed on page 1.
